description: Inference export contract for oriented-det (ONNX + TensorFlow/Keras detect bundle).

input.name: images
input.spatial: Fixed H×W at export time; batch size 1 for faster_rcnn_pre_nms.

backbone.onnx_outputs: Tuple of FPN feature maps in stable key order (see BackboneExportWrapper).
backbone.postprocess: None in ONNX; heads and decoding remain PyTorch or separate TF code.

retinanet_heads.onnx_outputs: Interleaved per level: level{i}_cls_logits, level{i}_bbox_pred (i from 0).
retinanet_heads.postprocess: Anchor grid, decode_oriented_boxes, score filter, rotated NMS — not in this ONNX.

faster_rcnn_pre_nms.postprocess: Exact CPU rotated NMS + production score_threshold in TF/Keras bundle (export/scripts/build_faster_rcnn_savedmodel.py).

notes: faster_rcnn_pre_nms pads RPN proposals to fixed P before ROI align for traceable ONNX.
onnx2tf SavedModel for this graph may fail on ScatterND; the detect bundle uses ONNX Runtime inside Keras.
TFLite full detect is not supported while NMS remains in Python.
